title: Surreal Cosmic Dreamscape
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a floating spherical world divided into colorful segments with a large stylized face at the bottom. A glowing green dog stands on a rocky outcrop to the left while a woman in flowing blue and pink robes floats above holding a bright orb of light.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting featuring a large spherical cosmic body divided into colorful segments with a stylized purple and orange face at the bottom. A glowing green dog with patterned fur stands on a floating rocky platform to the left. Above, a woman in flowing blue and pink robes floats gracefully holding a radiant orb of light. A pink waterfall cascades down from a small house on a cliff. Geometric red crystals, planets, and abstract shapes float in a swirling pink and blue sky.
